content: Flexible dieting (IIFYM) tracking practice: user-set macro targets (calories, protein, carbs, fat), daily remaining balance per macro, weekly adherence view (hitting targets most days beats daily perfection), diet phases (cutting, maintenance, bulking) with distinct targets, refeed days and diet breaks as advanced practice. RippedBody weekly-tracking guide corroborates weekly rhythm; direct search was rate limited so this digest leans on domain knowledge plus the MacroFactor comparison article. Confidence LOW to MEDIUM.
